g.text: Accuracy–memory trade-off, including adapted recent methods
All class-mean controls included. Adaptations are squares; no claim of reproducing published SOTA scores.
Error bars: SD across three seed means, each averaging forward/reverse task order. Optimizer/peak RAM excluded.
